specifications.title: Mission Critical Push To Talk (MCPTT) over LTE; Service requirements
Functional architecture and information flows to support MCPTT; Stage 2 (Rel-13)
Common functional architecture for mission critical services; Stage 2 (Rel-14+)
Mission Critical Push To Talk (MCPTT) media plane control; Stage 2 (Rel-14+)

stage1_clauses.title: Floor Control Requests & Queuing
stage1_clauses.requirement_summary: The MCPTT system shall support floor request, floor grant, floor override, and floor release under active call state.

stage1_clauses.title: Floor Override & Preemption
stage1_clauses.requirement_summary: The MCPTT system shall support pre-emptive floor control based on user priority level and emergency state.

stage1_clauses.title: Floor Control Audio Cut-in & Warning
stage1_clauses.requirement_summary: The system shall notify the current floor holder when floor is revoked or overridden.

stage1_clauses.title: Off-Network Floor Control
stage1_clauses.requirement_summary: The MCPTT system shall support floor control mechanisms when operating in off-network (ProSe) mode.

stage1_clauses.title: Dual-Floor / Multi-Talker Control
stage1_clauses.requirement_summary: The MCPTT system shall support multi-speaker audio mixing or dual-floor allocation for supervisor override.

stage2_clauses.title: Floor Control Server Centralized Topology
stage2_clauses.decision_summary: Floor control arbitration is centralized at the MCPTT Floor Control Server (Floor Control Host).

stage2_clauses.title: Floor Request Procedure over Unicast Signaling
stage2_clauses.decision_summary: Floor requests use SIP/RTP/RTCP control messages over unicast bearer between UE and Floor Control Server.

stage2_clauses.title: Split Architecture: Floor Control Server vs Media Distribution Function
stage2_clauses.decision_summary: Decouple control plane floor arbitration (Floor Control Server) from user plane media distribution (MDF).

stage2_clauses.title: Off-Network Floor Control Distributed Token Protocol
stage2_clauses.decision_summary: Off-network ProSe floor control utilizes distributed peer-to-peer token passing with timer-based collision recovery.

stage2_clauses.title: Floor Override Audio Preemption Protocol
stage2_clauses.decision_summary: Floor revoking sends Floor Granted to pre-emptor while sending Floor Revoked with reason code to incumbent speaker.
